title: 5 weightloss hacks to implement today
summary: For beginners, NH gives simple ways to create a caloric deficit: drink only water, stop snacking, never shop hungry, keep only diet food in the house, cook your own meals, and walk more. He frames weight loss as a game of not doing things.
claims: Weight loss comes down to a caloric deficit (calories in vs out), though it's more complicated in practice
Cut sodas, juices and energy drinks; drink only water, maybe some milk; this alone can lose 5-10 lb
Stop snacking; eat only at planned sit-down meals, even if that means 4-5 meals instead of 3
Dieters starve on salads then snack, and the snacks add up to more calories than meals
Never shop hungry: hungry shoppers buy 15-20% more products and gravitate toward fatty foods
Only eat what's in your house and don't buy junk, so there's nothing to cheat with
Don't eat out or order delivery; cook whole foods yourself for satiety and micronutrients, keeping restaurants as occasional treats
Walk instead of taking the bus, subway or car; take every chance to be active
Don't compensate for extra activity by overeating; endure the hunger
He has helped people lose 20 lb with these simple hacks
Weight loss is a game of not doing things, while weight gain requires action
